inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {r : ℕ} {S : Type} [inst_2 : Fintype S]
  {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ} {μ : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → ℝ} {L : ℕ} {β : ℝ},
  (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), 0 ≤ μ x) →
    QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalMass μ = 1 →
      (∀ (T : QuarticQuery.QueryTree κ), T.depth ≤ L → QuarticQuery.treeSuccess f μ T ≤ β) →
        ∀ {p : S → ℝ},
          (∀ (s : S), 0 ≤ p s) →
            ∑ s, p s = 1 →
              ∀ (T : S → QuarticQuery.OutTree (Fin r × κ) (Fin r → Bool)),
                (∀ (s : S), (T s).capped fun x => L) → ∑ s, p s * QuarticQuery.guessSuccess f (fun x => μ) (T s) ≤ β ^ r

statement: Let P:D->{0,1}, D subset {0,1}^n, mu a distribution on D, L a nonnegative integer. Suppose every deterministic algorithm making at most L queries computes P under mu with success probability <=beta. If U_1,...,U_r are iid mu, every classical algorithm making at most L queries to each U_h, possibly randomized, adaptive among the r inputs, and given arbitrary additional information independent of (U_1,...,U_r), outputs (P(U_1),...,P(U_r)) with probability <=beta^r.
